items.headline: Shortest PGA Tour Course
items.text: Port Royal Golf Course at the Butterfield Bermuda Championship is the shortest venue on the 2026 PGA Tour schedule at 6,828 yards but ranked as the 14th most difficult course in 2025 due to strong Bermuda winds.

items.headline: Westwood Slams DP World Tour Stance
items.text: Lee Westwood criticized the DP World Tour's position on LIV Golf in 2027, after spending nearly four years away from the Tour due to LIV Golf fines.
